title: The Tail Wagging the Dog: Dataset Construction Biases of Social Bias Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the stability and reliability of gender-occupation bias measurements by applying shallow, meaning-preserving syntactic modifications (such as adding clauses, synonym substitution, and verb negation) to existing benchmark datasets, specifically WinoGender (measuring male/female pronoun coreference resolution mismatches) and BiasNLI (measuring neutral inferences on gender-occupation sentence pairs).
